title: Monster Extra: Hottan
content:
It took me almost 3 years to get through Monster the Anime. Not for the wrong reasons, it was because of life got in the way, but I did resume watching it. But only after I finished it I found out about this recap.

Normally I’m very critical of recap special episodes, they cover way too little content and sometimes none of the he important stuff. However, this one would have saved me a lot of trouble trying to remember past event before I resume my watch. This was honestly a decent recap episode for the first half of the show.

It starts abruptly, it does skip a lot of events, but considering the amount of the episode it had to cover during the 20 minutes length I say it is impressive. I say, for what it is, it really highlights the biggest plot points in the first half and also leaves off on a sudden note.

Overall: 7.5/10.
